why: Properly clean up and deallocate EGL graphics context resources to prevent memory leaks and ensure safe context termination.
what: Releases all GPU and EGL context resources by checking the current active context, deactivating if necessary, destroying the context, and releasing the thread. Sets the internal context reference to None.
how: Checks if a context exists and validates if it's currently active before deactivating it, then calls EGL destruction and thread release functions in sequence, finally nullifying the stored reference.

inputs.name: self
inputs.role: Instance context containing the EGL context to be freed
inputs.constraints: Must be a valid EGLGLContext instance with _context attribute

outputs.meaning: No return value; method performs side effects on the instance

throws: May raise OpenGL.error.GLError if EGL function calls fail due to invalid context or state
